title: MVNN: A Measure-Valued Neural Network for Learning McKean-Vlasov Dynamics from Particle Data
abstract: arXiv:2604.00333v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Collective behaviors that emerge from interactions are fundamental to numerous biological systems. To learn such interacting forces from observations, we introduce a measure-valued neural network that infers measure-dependent interaction (drift) terms directly from particle-trajectory observations. The proposed architecture generalizes standard neural networks to operate on probability measures by learning cylindrical features, using an embedding network that produces scalable distribution-to-vector representations. On the theory side, we establish well-posedness of the resulting dynamics and prove propagation-of-chaos for the associated interacting-particle system. We further show universal approximation and quantitative approximation rates under a low-dimensional measure-dependence assumption. translated_title: MVNN：一种用于从粒子数据学习McKean-Vlasov动力学的测度值神经网络
translated_abstract: 由相互作用产生的集体行为是众多生物系统的基础。为了从观测数据中学习这类相互作用力，我们提出了一种测度值神经网络，可直接从粒子轨迹观测中推断依赖测度的相互作用（漂移）项。所提出的架构通过学习柱状特征，将标准神经网络推广到可在概率测度上运算，并使用嵌入网络产生可扩展的分布到向量表示。在理论方面，我们建立了所得动力学的适定性，并证明了相应相互作用粒子系统的混沌传播性质。我们进一步在低维测度依赖性假设下证明了万能逼近性以及定量逼近速率。数值实验在一阶和二阶系统上进行，包括确定性与随机性的Motsch-Tadmor动力学、二维（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种测度值神经网络MVNN，可直接从粒子轨迹数据中学习McKean-Vlasov动力学中依赖测度的相互作用项，并提供了适定性、混沌传播以及万能逼近与定量逼近速率等理论保证。
